components.name: Fractionless count-defect, exponent-coordinate, and valuation-repair layer
components.project_addition: Demotes finite rational normalization to external views of primitive integer count rays; packages ratio comparison, Bell separation, threshold tests and macro monotonicity as signed integer defects; linearizes P005 multiplicative scales into finite prime-exponent words with separate rank omega and total depth Omega; and proves a sharp P023/P024 specialization for capped p-adic valuation quotients: unequal-level addition is valuation-safe, equal-level carry is unbounded, level plus normalized unit residue is an exact finite repair, and a future language containing all translations modulo p^K forces p^K future-safe classes, eliminating all valuation-only compression. The underlying denominator clearing, projective counts, unique factorization, valuations, tropical/min-plus algebra, integer-cone linearity, binomial counting and fraction-free exact linear algebra are prior mathematics.
